badge.activeHint: Mythic power granted and enabled (only the GM sees this badge).
badge.disabledHint: Mythic power granted but disabled (only the GM sees this badge).

dialog.title: Grant Mythic Power: {name}
dialog.source: Source of power (shown on the sheet)
dialog.noCallings: No Callings found in the allowed sources.

standard.label: Standard
standard.hint: A mythic feat at every even level. {name} is level {level}, so {count} feats are owed now.

lateStart.label: Late start (catch-up)
lateStart.hint: {name} is level {level}: {count} owed feats are released one per session until caught up.

trials.label: Mythic trials (tiers)
trials.hint: Tier grows from trials, separately from level. The first trial grants the Calling (tier 0).
trials.hintNoTiers: Tier grows from trials, separately from level. Needs the PF2e setting "Mythic Rules" set to Alternate Mythic Progression.

card.whisper: Whisper to {name}'s owners and the GM

revoke.title: Revoke Mythic Power: {name}
revoke.content: Remove {name}'s Calling, mythic and destiny feats and all mythic data? This can't be undone. Use Disable to switch mythic power off and keep the choices.

ledger.disable: Disabled mythic power for {name} ({count} items stored).
ledger.enable: Enabled mythic power for {name} ({count} items restored).
ledger.revoke: Revoked mythic power from {name} ({count} items removed).

errors.notCharacter: Only player characters can be granted mythic power.
errors.trialsNeedTiers: Mythic trials need the PF2e setting "Mythic Rules" set to Alternate Mythic Progression.
errors.callingFailed: Couldn't add the Calling to {name}. See the console for details.
errors.pickCalling: Choose a Calling, or let the player choose.
errors.notOwner: Only the character's owners can choose its Calling.

settingCheck.title: Mythic Powers: PF2e Mythic Rules are off
settingCheck.content: Mythic Powers needs the PF2e system setting "Mythic Rules" to add Callings, mythic feats and Mythic Points.
settingCheck.hidden: Characters without a grant from you won't see any mythic slots: the module hides them.
settingCheck.trials: Some characters use mythic trials, so Alternate Mythic Progression will be selected.
settingCheck.trialsWarning: Mythic Powers: {names} use mythic trials, but the PF2e setting "Mythic Rules" isn't set to Alternate Mythic Progression, so tiers won't apply.
